description: This file defines the ExecutorPodsPollingSnapshotSource class used for polling Kubernetes executor pods in Apache Spark, including methods for starting and stopping polling, and internal logic for fetching pod states from Kubernetes API.

classes.name: ExecutorPodsPollingSnapshotSource
classes.description: A class used for polling Kubernetes executor pods, with methods to start and stop polling, and an internal runnable class for executing polling logic.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts polling for executor pods if enabled, scheduling periodic checks.

methods.name: stop
